name: Social Publisher: multi-client Facebook + Instagram scheduling and reports

parameters.content:
## 1. Add a client (onboarding)
The operator fills this form once per client. The Page token is checked with Meta **before** anything is saved, then stored encrypted in Supabase Vault. The Instagram id is filled in automatically from the Page.

parameters.formDescription: Connect a client's Facebook Page and Instagram account.

options.queryReplacement: ={{ (c => [c.id, c.name, c.fb_page_id, $json.instagram_business_account?.id ?? null, c.timezone, c.report_email, c.token])($('Check client').item.json) }}

parameters.completionMessage: ={{ $('Check client').item.json.name }} is connected: Facebook Page "{{ $('Verify token with Meta').item.json.name }}"{{ $('Verify token with Meta').item.json.instagram_business_account ? ' and Instagram @' + $('Verify token with Meta').item.json.instagram_business_account.username : ' (no Instagram account linked to this Page)' }}.
={{ $json.problem || ('Meta did not accept this Page id and token: ' + ($json.error?.description || $json.error?.message || 'unknown error')) }}

parameters.content:
## 2. Schedule a post
The content goes in through a form: media URL, caption, hashtags, link and time. It's checked against the same rules Meta applies, so a post that is accepted here will publish.

parameters.formDescription: Schedule an image or reel for a client.

parameters.query:
WITH c AS (SELECT id FROM marketing.clients WHERE id = $1 AND active),
p AS (
  INSERT INTO marketing.posts (id, client_id, type, media_url, caption, hashtags, link, link_on_instagram, scheduled_at)
  SELECT $2, c.id, $3, $4, $5, $6::text[], NULLIF($7, ''), $8, $9::timestamptz FROM c
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
),
t AS (INSERT INTO marketing.post_targets (post_id, platform) SELECT p.id, unnest($10::text[]) FROM p RETURNING 1)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM c) AS client_found, (SELECT count(*) FROM p) AS created, (SELECT count(*) FROM t) AS targets;

parameters.completionMessage: ={{ $json.problem || (Number($json.client_found) === 0 ? 'No active client with this id.' : Number($json.created) === 0 ? 'A post with this id already exists.' : 'Scheduled: ' + $('Check post').item.json.id + ' on ' + $('Check post').item.json.platforms.join(' and ') + '.') }}

parameters.content:
## 3. Publisher, every 15 minutes, all clients
1. Close finished posts (posted, partial or failed)
2. Load due posts per platform with each client's token from Vault
3. **Facebook**: one call. **Instagram**: create a container, wait until Meta has processed it (next run if needed), then publish
4. Any error: up to 3 attempts, then the client gets an alert email. A token problem stops right away. One platform failing never blocks the other

parameters.query:
-- A post is done once no platform is still pending or processing.
UPDATE marketing.posts p
SET status = CASE WHEN s.posted = s.total THEN 'posted' WHEN s.posted = 0 THEN 'failed' ELSE 'partial' END,
    updated_at = now()
FROM (SELECT post_id, count(*) AS total,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'posted') AS posted,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('pending', 'processing')) AS open
      FROM marketing.post_targets GROUP BY post_id) s
WHERE p.id = s.post_id AND p.status = 'publishing' AND s.open = 0
RETURNING p.id, p.status;

WITH due AS (
  SELECT t.post_id, t.platform
  FROM marketing.post_targets t
  JOIN marketing.posts p ON p.id = t.post_id
  JOIN marketing.clients c ON c.id = p.client_id AND c.active
  WHERE p.status IN ('scheduled', 'publishing') AND p.scheduled_at <= now()
    AND t.status IN ('pending', 'processing')
  ORDER BY p.scheduled_at
  LIMIT 20
), started AS (
  UPDATE marketing.posts SET status = 'publishing', updated_at = now()
  WHERE status = 'scheduled' AND id IN (SELECT post_id FROM due)
)
SELECT p.id, p.type, p.media_url, p.caption, p.hashtags, p.link, p.link_on_instagram, p.scheduled_at,
       t.platform, t.status AS target_status, t.container_id, t.attempts,
       c.id AS client_id, c.name AS client_name, c.fb_page_id, c.ig_user_id, c.timezone, c.report_email,
       s.decrypted_secret AS token
FROM due d
JOIN marketing.post_targets t ON t.post_id = d.post_id AND t.platform = d.platform
JOIN marketing.posts p ON p.id = d.post_id
JOIN marketing.clients c ON c.id = p.client_id
LEFT JOIN vault.decrypted_secrets s ON s.name = 'meta_token:' || c.id
ORDER BY p.scheduled_at;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ (p => { const id = String($json.post_id ?? $json.id); return [p.id, 'facebook', id, p.type === 'reel' ? `https://www.facebook.com/${p.fb_page_id}/videos/${id}` : `https://www.facebook.com/${id}`]; })($('Prepare posts').item.json) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify($json.type === 'reel' ? { media_type: 'REELS', video_url: $json.media_url, caption: $json.final_caption, share_to_feed: true } : { image_url: $json.media_url, caption: $json.final_caption }) }}

parameters.query:
-- A failed Instagram container cannot be reused, so the next attempt starts a new one.
UPDATE marketing.post_targets
SET status = CASE WHEN $5 THEN 'failed' ELSE 'pending' END, container_id = NULL, error = $3, attempts = $4, updated_at = now()
WHERE post_id = $1 AND platform = $2
RETURNING status;

parameters.content:
## 4. Daily at 18:00
**Top:** each client gets the list of posts going out in the next 24 hours, so they can stop one in time (no email on quiet days).
**Bottom:** results for posts from the last 30 days are read from Meta and stored, so reports never wait on Meta.

parameters.query:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.timezone, c.report_email,
  json_agg(json_build_object(
    'id', p.id, 'type', p.type, 'caption', p.caption, 'hashtags', p.hashtags, 'media_url', p.media_url, 'at', p.scheduled_at,
    'platforms', (SELECT string_agg(platform, ', ' ORDER BY platform) FROM marketing.post_targets t WHERE t.post_id = p.id)
  ) ORDER BY p.scheduled_at) AS posts
FROM marketing.posts p
JOIN marketing.clients c ON c.id = p.client_id AND c.active
WHERE p.status = 'scheduled' AND p.scheduled_at BETWEEN now() AND now() + interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY c.id;

-- Oldest results first, capped so one run stays well inside Meta's rate limits.
SELECT t.post_id, t.platform, t.remote_id, p.type, s.decrypted_secret AS token,
  t.remote_id || CASE
    WHEN t.platform = 'instagram' THEN '/insights?metric=reach,views,likes,comments,saved,shares'
    WHEN p.type = 'reel' THEN '?fields=likes.summary(total_count).limit(0),comments.summary(total_count).limit(0),video_insights.metric(blue_reels_play_count)'
    ELSE '?fields=reactions.summary(total_count).limit(0),comments.summary(total_count).limit(0),shares,insights.metric(post_total_media_view_unique,post_media_view)'
  END AS path
FROM marketing.post_targets t
JOIN marketing.posts p ON p.id = t.post_id
JOIN marketing.clients c ON c.id = p.client_id AND c.active
LEFT JOIN marketing.post_insights i ON i.post_id = t.post_id AND i.platform = t.platform
LEFT JOIN vault.decrypted_secrets s ON s.name = 'meta_token:' || c.id
WHERE t.status = 'posted' AND t.posted_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
ORDER BY i.fetched_at NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 50;

INSERT INTO marketing.post_insights (post_id, platform, reach, views, likes, comments, shares, saves, raw, error, fetched_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9::jsonb, $10, now())
ON CONFLICT (post_id, platform) DO UPDATE SET
  -- a failed read keeps the last good numbers
  reach = COALESCE(excluded.reach, marketing.post_insights.reach), views = COALESCE(excluded.views, marketing.post_insights.views),
  likes = COALESCE(excluded.likes, marketing.post_insights.likes), comments = COALESCE(excluded.comments, marketing.post_insights.comments),
  shares = COALESCE(excluded.shares, marketing.post_insights.shares), saves = COALESCE(excluded.saves, marketing.post_insights.saves),
  raw = CASE WHEN excluded.error IS NULL THEN excluded.raw ELSE marketing.post_insights.raw END,
  error = excluded.error, fetched_at = excluded.fetched_at;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$json.post_id, $json.platform, $json.reach ?? null, $json.views ?? null, $json.likes ?? null, $json.comments ?? null, $json.shares ?? null, $json.saves ?? null, JSON.stringify($json.raw), $json.error] }}

parameters.content:
## 5. Weekly report, Mondays 09:00
Per client: followers and the change since last week, results for each post, failed posts, and a short written analysis from Gemini. If Gemini is down, the report still goes out without the analysis. Each week is saved for comparison.

parameters.query:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.timezone, c.report_email, c.fb_page_id, s.decrypted_secret AS token,
  (now() - interval '7 days')::date AS week_start, now()::date AS week_end,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', p.id, 'type', p.type, 'platform', t.platform, 'permalink', t.permalink,
      'reach', i.reach, 'views', i.views, 'likes', i.likes, 'comments', i.comments, 'shares', i.shares, 'saves', i.saves) ORDER BY t.posted_at)
    FROM marketing.post_targets t JOIN marketing.posts p ON p.id = t.post_id
    LEFT JOIN marketing.post_insights i ON i.post_id = t.post_id AND i.platform = t.platform
    WHERE p.client_id = c.id AND t.status = 'posted' AND t.posted_at >= now() - interval '7 days'), '[]') AS posts,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', p.id, 'platform', t.platform, 'error', t.error))
    FROM marketing.post_targets t JOIN marketing.posts p ON p.id = t.post_id
    WHERE p.client_id = c.id AND t.status = 'failed' AND t.updated_at >= now() - interval '7 days'), '[]') AS failed,
  (SELECT r.data -> 'followers' FROM marketing.reports r WHERE r.client_id = c.id ORDER BY r.week_start DESC LIMIT 1) AS prev_followers
FROM marketing.clients c
LEFT JOIN vault.decrypted_secrets s ON s.name = 'meta_token:' || c.id
WHERE c.active;

parameters.content:
## Social Publisher
Multi-client Facebook + Instagram publishing, previews and reports.

1. Run `setup.sql` in Supabase once
2. **Basic Auth** credential on both forms (operator only)
3. Select **Postgres** in every Postgres node
4. Select an **SMTP** credential in the four email nodes and replace `YOUR_FROM_EMAIL`
5. *Gemini analysis*: **Header Auth**, name `x-goog-api-key`
6. Settings > Error workflow: **Error Alerts**
7. Add a client with the form, schedule a test post, publish
